يشتعلوا (form VIII)
# يَشْتَعِلُوا (yaštaʕilū) /jaʃ.ta.ʕi.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# يُشْتَعَلُوا (yuštaʕalū) /juʃ.ta.ʕa.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
